rationale: Stand aside. The scan's 'long' is a weak 36.7% composite driven purely by exhausting lower-TF momentum (15m/30m up) while every quality filter points the other way: structure_bias -0.461 with a heavily crowded long/short ratio of 3.175 (squeeze/flush fuel), sell-heavy order book (-0.097), and an explicit bearish divergence flag on RSI ~60 into resistance. This is a tokenized US equity with the underlying market CLOSED for July 4 (no price discovery, thin/gappy, exposed to a Monday Jul 6 reopen gap) and a live structural overhang from the Open USD launch that already crashed CRCL ~17.5%. A fresh long is the wrong side of the crowd and the news; a contrarian short is thesis-consistent but the razor-thin support at $66.91 (~0.6% below spot) offers no clean stop and I refuse to carry naked exposure across the reopen gap. No 48h catalyst justifies forcing a trade — HOLD is the highest-expectancy choice here. Flip to a short only on a decisive loss of support.

reconsider.note: Losing the $66.91 support floor confirms the crowded-long flush and opens a thesis-consistent short toward the mid-$64s.
